local Modules = {}
local Manifest = {}


local function unpackPacked(values)
    return table.unpack(values, 1, values.n)
end

local function movePackedValues(target, offset, ...)
    local values = table.pack(...)
    table.move(values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, target)
end

local function appendPackedValues(target, offset, values)
    for index = 1, values.n do
        target[offset + index] = values[index]
    end
    target.n = offset + values.n
end




local function bindCapturedPrototype(prototypeIndex, captureMapIndex, descriptors, prototypes, externalCaptures, environment)
    local prototype = prototypes[prototypeIndex]
    local captureMap = prototypes[captureMapIndex]
    local boundCaptures
    if captureMap then
        local count = #captureMap / 3
        if count > 0 then
            boundCaptures = {}
            for captureIndex = 1, count do
                local offset = (captureIndex - 1) * 3
                local sourceIndex = captureMap[offset + 1]
                local captureKind = captureMap[offset + 2]
                if captureKind == 2 then
                    boundCaptures[captureIndex] = { [5] = descriptors[sourceIndex], [4] = sourceIndex }
                elseif captureKind == 0 then
                    boundCaptures[captureIndex] = descriptors[sourceIndex][sourceIndex]
                elseif captureKind == 1 then
                    boundCaptures[captureIndex] = externalCaptures[sourceIndex]
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local closure = prototype(boundCaptures, nil)
    if environment then setfenv(closure, environment) end
    return closure
end

local function bindDirectPrototype(prototypeIndex, captureMapIndex, prototypes, externalCaptures, environment)
    local prototype = prototypes[prototypeIndex]
    local captureMap = prototypes[captureMapIndex]
    local boundCaptures
    if captureMap then
        local count = #captureMap / 3
        if count > 0 then
            boundCaptures = {}
            for captureIndex = 1, count do
                boundCaptures[captureIndex] = externalCaptures[captureMap[(captureIndex - 1) * 3 + 1]]
            end
        end
    end
    local closure = prototype(boundCaptures, nil)
    if environment then setfenv(closure, environment) end
    return closure
end
